from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the party")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the litigation")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    amount: float = Field(description="Fee amount")
    phase: str = Field(description="Proceeding phase")
    bearers: list[str] = Field(description="Parties bearing the fee")

class Amount(BaseModel):
    value: float = Field(description="Monetary value")
    description: str = Field(description="Nature of the amount")

class Ruling(BaseModel):
    decision_type: str = Field(description="Main ruling action")
    description: str = Field(description="Full outcome text")

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    document_index: str = Field(description="Identifier for the document (e.g., 1, 2)")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="Parties involved")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Court name")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Case reference number")
    dispute_type: str = Field(description="Nature of the dispute")
    ruling: Ruling = Field(description="The court's decision")
    fees: list[Fee] = Field(description="Court fee details")
    amounts: list[Amount] = Field(description="Other monetary details")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
